footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Barclays: after £41.0M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income.

Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 3.7% to £11.1B in 2025. Operating income rose 12.7% to £9.1B, a 82.3% margin.
Net income rose 13.7% to £7.2B, or £0.42 per share. Operating cash flow was £18.7B and free cash flow £16.9B, versus £5.5B; Barclays returned £6.9B through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Barclays PLC Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
